description:
From cavemen and creation to angels, baptism, and the two witnesses of Revelation—viewers bring honest and heartfelt questions to the table. In this Bible Q&A, the panel discusses topics such as who the Nicolaitans were, whether we’ll remember our earthly lives in Heaven, the differences between the Seventh-day Adventist Church and the Church of God, women preaching in the church, and much more. Join us as we search the Scriptures for clear answers to today’s most thought-provoking questions.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. What can you tell me about the Nicolaitans? 

2. If Adam and Eve were created first, what about cavemen who were around millions of years ago? We have evidence of cavemen before Adam and Eve. Can you please explain? 

3.  If someone is already baptized by immersion in the name of Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, why does the Seventh-day Adventist Church want that person to be re-baptized? Do we need to be re-baptized? 

4. Would you please explain Hebrews 4:9? 

5.  Will we remember our life here on Earth when we go to Heaven or the New Earth?

6. Is there such a thing as a person dying "too soon"? Doesn't God have our lives, steps, and situations preordained? 

7. I was discussing with other Seventh-day Sabbath keepers and received some insight from a member of The Church of God. From what I saw, their main difference seems to be their non-belief in E. G. White as a prophet. Are there other significant differences?  What are some of the differences in the theological beliefs between the Seventh-day Adventist Church and the Church of God? 

8.  Who are the two witnesses in Revelation 11? 

9.  On what day did God create the angels? 

10.  Why are women allowed to preach from the pulpit if the scriptures say they shouldn't? Are women allowed to preach?

11.  Where is God’s throne in the Heavenly Sanctuary? 

12. I had a dream where the Spirit asked me, "why don't you give God a chance?" How do I give God a chance?
